lessons.title: The final exam
lessons.text: Four 'Mechs each. Everything you learned applies: read the to-hit numbers, count the heat, protect your rear and pick your melee fights. If the lessons feel familiar, set Explanations to Light from the button on the screen.

lessons.title: The river
lessons.text: Water slows a 'Mech down and hides the part of it that is under the surface: legs in depth 1 water get partial cover, and a 'Mech fully under water can only use some weapons. Water also cools: standing in it helps your heat sinks. The bridge crosses dry.

lessons.title: Jumping
lessons.text: Jump jets carry a 'Mech over water, woods and hills in a straight hop, one MP per hex. It's the hardest movement to hit (+1 on top of the hexes moved), but your own shots are +3 that turn and jumping makes heat.

lessons.title: One down
lessons.text: An enemy 'Mech is out of the fight. Each one you remove means fewer shots at your lance next turn. Pick the next target: the closest, the most dangerous, or the one already damaged.

lessons.title: Training complete
lessons.text: Basic training complete. Continue into the Advanced Tactical Academy or replay any exercise.
